# /etc/fstab comment line should be ignored by the mounts parser
proc /proc proc defaults 0 0
/dev/nvme0n1p2 / ext4 rw,relatime 0 1
/dev/nvme0n1p2 /home ext4 rw,relatime 0 1
/dev/sda1 /mnt/backup ext4 rw,relatime 0 1
tmpfs /run/user/1000 tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,relatime,size=... 0 0
/dev/sdb1 /mnt/backup ntfs-3g rw,relatime 0 0
snapper-testfs /mnt/other indis-fs rw,relatime 0 0
